arxiv-2006-08972.title: Valuation rings of dimension one as limits of smooth algebras
arxiv-2006-08972.creator: Dorin Popescu
arxiv-2006-08972.description: Abstract . As in Zariski’s Uniformization Theorem we show that a valuation ring V V of characteristic p > 0 p>0 of dimension one is a filtered direct limit of smooth 𝐅 p {\bf F}_{p} -algebras under some conditions of transcendence degree.

arxiv-2105-08178.title: A Dynamical Quantum Daemon
arxiv-2105-08178.creator: J. I. Castro–Alatorre, D. Condado, E. Sadurní
arxiv-2105-08178.description: Abstract We study the irreversibility à la Maxwell from a quantum point of view, involving an arbitrarily large ensemble of independent particles, with a daemonic potential that is capable of inducing asymmetries in the evolution, exhibiting new perspectives on how Maxwell’s apparent paradox is posed and resolved dynamically.

arxiv-2106-04274.title: 3D Human Pose Estimation Based on 2D-3D Consistency with Synchronized Adversarial Training Journal: Robotics and Autonomous Systems
arxiv-2106-04274.creator: Yicheng Deng, Cheng Sun, Yongqi Sun, Jiahui Zhu
arxiv-2106-04274.description: Abstract 3D human pose estimation from a single image is still a challenging problem despite the large amount of work that has been performed in this field. Generally, most methods directly use neural networks and ignore certain constraints (e.g., reprojection constraints, joint angle, and bone length constraints).

arxiv-2109-13220.title: Feeble Metallicity and Robust Semiconducting Regime in Structurally Sensitive Ba(Pb, Sn)O 3 Alloys
arxiv-2109-13220.creator: Ravi Kashikar, B. R. K. Nanda
arxiv-2109-13220.description: Abstract Density functional calculations are carried out to study the symmetry and substitution-driven electronic phase transition in BaPb 1-x Sn x O 3 . Two end members BaSnO 3 and BaPbO 3 , are found to be insulating and metallic, respectively.

arxiv-2209-00465.title: AAAI 2023 On Grounded Planning for Embodied Tasks with Language Models
arxiv-2209-00465.creator: Bill Yuchen Lin, Chengsong Huang, Qian Liu, Wenda Gu, Sam Sommerer, Xiang Ren
arxiv-2209-00465.description: Abstract Language models (LMs) have demonstrated their capability in possessing commonsense knowledge of the physical world, a crucial aspect of performing tasks in everyday life. However, it remains unclear whether they have the capacity to generate grounded, executable plans for embodied tasks.

arxiv-2209-05112.title: A challenge-based survey of e-recruitment recommendation systems Journal: CSUR CCS: General and reference Surveys and overviews CCS: Information systems Recommender systems
arxiv-2209-05112.creator: Yoosof Mashayekhi, Nan Li, Bo Kang, Jefrey Lijffijt, Tijl De Bie
arxiv-2209-05112.description: Abstract . E-recruitment recommendation systems recommend jobs to job seekers and job seekers to recruiters. The recommendations are generated based on the suitability of the job seekers for the positions as well as the job seekers’ and the recruiters’ preferences. Therefore, e-recruitment recommendation systems could greatly impact job seekers’ careers.

arxiv-2212-13076.title: Assessment of URANS and LES Methods in Predicting Wake Shed Behind a Vertical Axis Wind Turbine
arxiv-2212-13076.creator: Armin Sheidani, Sajad Salavatidezfouli, Giovanni Stabile, Gianluigi Rozza
arxiv-2212-13076.description: Abstract In order to shed light on the Vertical-Axis Wind Turbines (VAWT) wake characteristics, in this paper we present high-fidelity CFD simulations of the flow around an exemplary H-shaped VAWT turbine, and we propose to apply Proper Orthogonal Decomposition (POD) to the computed flow field in the near wake of the rotor.

arxiv-2304-01097.title: DoctorGLM: Fine-tuning your Chinese Doctor is not a Herculean Task
arxiv-2304-01097.creator: Honglin Xiong*, Sheng Wang*, Yitao Zhu*, Zihao Zhao*, Yuxiao Liu, Linlin Huang, Qian Wang, Dinggang Shen
arxiv-2304-01097.description: Abstract The recent progress of large language models (LLMs), including ChatGPT and GPT-4, in comprehending and responding to human instructions has been remarkable. Nevertheless, these models typically perform better in English and have not been explicitly trained for the medical domain, resulting in suboptimal precision in diagnoses, drug recommendations, and other medical advice.

arxiv-2310-06587.title: Gauge field smearing and controlled continuum extrapolations
arxiv-2310-06587.description: Abstract Two popular methods to reduce discretisation effects are Symanzik improvement and gauge field smearing in the Dirac operator. Tree-level O ⁡ ( a 2 ) O(a^{2}) -improved Wilson fermions can be obtained from O ⁡ ( a ) O(a) -improved Wilson fermions by adding one dimension-6 operator to the action.

arxiv-2311-06568.title: On a fallacy concerning I-am-unprovable sentences: what to take home from Gödel’s introduction
arxiv-2311-06568.creator: Kaave Lajevardi La Société des Philosophes Chômeurs, P.O.Box 13197-73587, Téhéran, IRAN. E-mail: kaave.lajevardi@gmail.com Saeed Salehi Research Center of Biosciences & Biotechnology (RCBB), University of Tabriz, P.O.Box 51666–16471, Tabriz, IRAN. E-mail: root@SaeedSalehi.ir
arxiv-2311-06568.description: Abstract We demonstrate that, in itself and in the absence of extra premises, the following argument scheme is fallacious: The sentence A says about itself that it has a certain property F, and A does in fact have the property F; therefore A is true.

arxiv-2408-13295.title: Exploring Bias and Prediction Metrics to Characterise the Fairness of Machine Learning for Equity-Centered Public Health Decision-Making: A Narrative Review
arxiv-2408-13295.creator: Shaina Raza 1, Arash Shaban-Nejad 2, Elham Dolatabadi 3, Hiroshi Mamiya 4
arxiv-2408-13295.description: Abstract Background : The rapid advancement of Machine Learning (ML) represents novel opportunities to enhance public health research, surveillance, and decision-making. However, there is a lack of comprehensive understanding of algorithmic bias — systematic errors in predicted population health outcomes — resulting from the public health application of ML.

arxiv-2501-09991.title: Graph colouring and Steenrod’s problem for Stanley-Reisner rings
arxiv-2501-09991.creator: Donald Stanley, Masahiro Takeda
arxiv-2501-09991.description:
A 2025 arXiv research paper by Donald Stanley, Masahiro Takeda. It is a classical problem in algebraic topology asked by Steenrod in [ S ] which graded rings occurs as the cohomology ring of a space. In this paper, we define an algebraic version of the graph colouring, span colouring, and observe the relation between span colourings and Steenrod’s problem for graded Stanley-Reisner rings, in other words polynomial rings divided by an ideal generated by square-free monic monomials. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification
55N10, 55S10, 13F55, 05C15

1.

arxiv-2503-02866.title: Optimal Power Management for Large-Scale Battery Energy Storage Systems via Bayesian Inference
arxiv-2503-02866.creator: Amir Farakhor, Iman Askari, Di Wu, Yebin Wang, Huazhen Fang
arxiv-2503-02866.description: Abstract Large-scale battery energy storage systems (BESS) have found ever-increasing use across industry and society to accelerate clean energy transition and improve energy supply reliability and resilience. However, their optimal power management poses significant challenges: the underlying high-dimensional nonlinear nonconvex optimization lacks computational tractability in real-world implementation, and the uncertainty of the exogenous power demand makes exact optimization difficult.

arxiv-2504-09558.title: BIT: Battery-free, IC-less and Wireless Smart Textile Interface and Sensing System Conference: CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; April 26-May 1, 2025; Yokohama, Japan CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI ’25), April 26-May 1, 2025, Yokohama, Japan DOI: 10.114
arxiv-2504-09558.creator: Weiye Xu, Tony Li, Yuntao Wang, Xing-Dong Yang, Te-Yen Wu
arxiv-2504-09558.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Weiye Xu, Tony Li, Yuntao Wang, Xing-Dong Yang, Te-Yen Wu. The development of smart textile interfaces is hindered by the inclusion of rigid hardware components and batteries within the fabric, which pose challenges in terms of manufacturability, usability, and environmental concerns related to electronic waste. To mitigate these issues, we propose a smart textile interface and its wireless sensing system to eliminate the need for ICs, batteries, and connectors embedded into textiles.

arxiv-2506-19092.title: Simulated impact on LSST data of Starlink V1.5 and V2 satellites
arxiv-2506-19092.creator: Phanindra Kandula, J. Anthony Tyson, Jacob Askari, Forrest Fankhauser
arxiv-2506-19092.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Phanindra Kandula, J. Anthony Tyson, Jacob Askari, Forrest Fankhauser. In order to reduce the impact on ground-based optical astronomy, the new Starlink V2 satellites incorporate improvements to the chassis brightness through dielectric mirrors, off-pointing solar arrays, and black paint on exposed components. To assess the effectiveness of these mitigations for the general case in which the reflectivities are initially unknown, we simulate LSST operations and repeated photometry of every satellite in simulated model constellations.

arxiv-2509-00134.title: The effect of predation on the dynamics of Chronic Wasting Disease in deer
arxiv-2509-00134.creator: Cody E. FitzGerald, James P. Keener
arxiv-2509-00134.description: Abstract 1 Abstract Chronic Wasting Disease (CWD) is a neurological disease impacting deer, elk, moose, and other cervid populations and is caused by a misfolded protein known as a prion. CWD is difficult to control due to the persistence of prions in the environment.

europmc-pmc3628087.title: DNA deaminases induce break-associated mutation showers with implication of APOBEC3B and 3A in breast cancer kataegis.
europmc-pmc3628087.creator: Taylor BJ, Nik-Zainal S, Wu YL, Stebbings LA, Raine K, Campbell PJ, Rada C, Stratton MR, Neuberger MS.
europmc-pmc3628087.description: Breast cancer genomes have revealed a novel form of mutation showers (kataegis) in which multiple same-strand substitutions at C:G pairs spaced one to several hundred nucleotides apart are clustered over kilobase-sized regions, often associated with sites of DNA rearrangement....

pmc-10638434.title: Repeated multi-domain cognitive training prevents cognitive decline, anxiety and amyloid pathology found in a mouse model of Alzheimer disease
pmc-10638434.creator: Jogender Mehla, Scott H. Deibel, Hadil Karem, Nancy S. Hong, Shakhawat R. Hossain, Sean G. Lacoursiere, Robert J. Sutherland, Majid H. Mohajerani, Robert J. McDonald
pmc-10638434.description: Education, occupation, and an active lifestyle, comprising enhanced social, physical, and mental components are associated with improved cognitive functions in aged people and may delay the progression of various neurodegenerative diseases including Alzheimer’s disease. To investigate this protective effect, 3-month-old APPNL-G-F/NL-G-F mice were exposed to repeated single- or multi-domain cognitive training.

pmc-11277269.title: A catalyst family of high-entropy alloy atomic layers with square atomic arrangements comprising iron- and platinum-group metals
pmc-11277269.creator: Cheng-Yu Wu, Yueh-Chun Hsiao, Yi Chen, Kun-Han Lin, Tsung-Ju Lee, Chong-Chi Chi, Jui-Tai Lin, Liang-Ching Hsu, Hsin-Jung Tsai, Jia-Qi Gao, Chun-Wei Chang, I-Ting Kao, Chia-Ying Wu, Ying-Rui Lu, Chih-Wen Pao, Sung-Fu Hung, Ming-Yen Lu, Shan Zhou, Tung-Han Yang
pmc-11277269.description: We report a catalyst family of high-entropy alloy (HEA) atomic layers having three elements from iron-group metals (IGMs) and two elements from platinum-group metals (PGMs). Ten distinct quinary compositions of IGM-PGM-HEA with precisely controlled square atomic arrangements are used to explore their impact on hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) and hydrogen oxidation reaction (HOR).

pmc-11355943.title: Chloride Penetration of Surface-Coated Concrete: Review and Outlook
pmc-11355943.creator: Jing Liao, Yuchi Wang, Xiping Sun, Yuanzhan Wang
pmc-11355943.description: Concrete coatings show significant promise in shielding concrete substrates from corrosion by effectively resisting harmful ions and moisture. Thanks to their practicality, high efficiency, and cost-effectiveness, coatings are considered a potent technique for enhancing the chloride resistance of reinforced concrete structures. Over recent decades, extensive research has concentrated on employing coatings to bolster concrete’s ability to withstand chloride penetration.

pmc-11452420.title: Enhanced lymphangiogenesis in the left lateral segment of a biopsied liver during portoenterostomy for biliary atresia
pmc-11452420.creator: Yudai Tsuruno, Koshiro Sugita, Toshihiro Muraji, Ryuta Masuya, Toshio Harumatsu, Keisuke Yano, Shun Onishi, Takafumi Kawano, Chihiro Ichikawa, Haruo Ohtani, Yuko Bitoh, Satoshi Ieiri
pmc-11452420.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). PurposeWe investigate the histopathology of the portal vein branches and lymphatic vessels to elucidate the mechanism of atrophy of the left lateral segment (LLS) of the liver in biliary atresia (BA).MethodsLLS and right anterior segment (RAS) liver biopsy samples obtained during Kasai portoenterostomy (KPE) from ten consecutive patients with BA underwent histopathological investigation of the portal vein and lymphatic vessels using double chromogenic immunostaining for CD31/D2-40 and the hepatitis-like findings (HLF) score.

pmc-12592521.title: Revisiting Fluorobenzene as Diluents in Ether-Based Electrolytes for Lithium Metal Batteries
pmc-12592521.creator: Hongji Pan, Tiantian Wang, Yanxin Jiang, Jingjing Ouyang, Lu Chen, Zeyi Wang, Chunlei Song, Nanshan Chen, Qing Yan, Xin Li, Shumin Wu, Tianshuai Wang, Yiju Li
pmc-12592521.description: The localized high-concentration electrolyte based on the low-cost, low-density, low-viscosity, and low-fluorine-substitution fluorobenzene diluents and 1,2-dimethoxyethane solvents has been successfully demonstrated in high-performance lithium metal batteries. However, it requires high salt-to-solvent molar ratio, which causes high production costs and great environmental burden. Decreasing the salt-to-solvent molar ratio without sacrificing its electrochemical performance remains a challenge.

pmc-12751144.title: Glandular odontogenic cyst: a ten-case series and literature review with emphasis on radiological diagnostic challenges
pmc-12751144.creator: Young-Eun Kwon, So-Young Choi, Mee-seon Kim, Chang-Hyeon An, Seo-Young An
pmc-12751144.description: BackgroundGlandular odontogenic cyst (GOC) is a rare developmental odontogenic lesion characterized by histological complexity and significant radiological overlap with other cystic or neoplastic jaw lesions. Its nonspecific imaging features often lead to misdiagnosis, delaying appropriate treatment and increasing the risk of recurrence. Despite its clinical relevance, radiographic analysis of GOC remains underreported in the literature.

pmc-13039814.title: A high-quality Chromosome-level genome assembly of Gynostemma guangxiense (Cucurbitaceae)
pmc-13039814.creator: Xiao Zhang, Hao Zhang, Chen Chen, Yuemei Zhao
pmc-13039814.description: Gynostemma guangxiense X. X. Chen & D. H. Qin, belonging to the family Cucurbitaceae, is a perennial creeping herbaceous plant endemic to China with potential medicinal and health value. Here, we report the high-quality chromosome-level genome of G. guangxiense obtained by integrating Illumina short read, PacBio high-fidelity (HiFi) long read, Hi-C, and RNA-Seq technologies.

pmc-13040803.title: Effects of exogenous melatonin on photosynthesis physiology biochemistry of blue honeysuckle seedlings under saline-alkali stress
pmc-13040803.creator: Shuxian Li, Xueying Zhao, Jiacheng Liu, Zongya Xing, Yu Zheng, Junwei Huo, Dong Qin
pmc-13040803.description: Saline-alkali stress severely restricts the growth and cultivation of blue honeysuckle (Lonicera caerulea L.). Exogenous melatonin (MT) regulates plant stress resistance, but its alleviation mechanism in this species remains unclear. This study analyzed the effects of 0, 25, 100, and 200 µmol/L MT on blue honeysuckle seedlings under saline-alkali stress.

pmc-13317125.title: Persistent transcriptomic changes following repeated exposure to wood smoke in nonhuman primate airway epithelial cells
pmc-13317125.creator: Evan Holmes, Anthony P Brown, Sweeney P Elston, Christopher M Royer, Hong Ji

pmc-13677069.title: UcTCRp: a TCRβ-based framework for identifying and profiling MAIT- and iNKT-associated repertoire signals
pmc-13677069.creator: Linlin Chen, Yueyi Li, Shiwen Shan, Kaixuan Wang, Chao Feng, Yunsheng Dou, Qihang Xu, Linru Cai, Hao Wang, Haiyang Wang, Xiaochen Bo, Jian Zhang
pmc-13677069.description: Mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells and invariant natural killer T (iNKT) cells are conventionally identified using invariant or semi-invariant TCRα chains, antigen-loaded tetramers, or transcriptomic phenotypes. These requirements limit their detection in public and clinical immune-repertoire datasets that contain only TCRβ sequences.
